metadata.name: SaveEditMyInfo
metadata.description: Use this API to update a cardholder's PII (personal identification information), address information, and additional information (if applicable).

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: Cardholder First Name Valid Values: A-Z, a-z Example: Andrew Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MiddleName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Middle Name Valid values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Charles Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Last Name Valid values:A-Z, a-z Example: Hudson Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 of the Cardholder Valid values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 of the Cardholder Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 mecca way Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: POBOX
request_fields.description: Cardholder's PO Box Number. Valid Values:0-9 Example : 1312276 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: Cardholder's City of residence Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder Postal Code of Residence Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: Cardholder State of residence Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: GA Please refer Appendix Section : State Codes (US) Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: Two Character Country Code Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Refer Appendix section : Country Code Values Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: MobilePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder's Mobile Phone Number Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9876543210 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: MobilePhoneCountryCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder's Mobile Phone Country Code. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 91 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneCountryCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder's work phone country code. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 91 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder  Work Phone Number Valid values:0-9 Example:9632581470 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: FaxNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder's FAX number. Valid values are 0-9 Example:9632581470 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneExtension
request_fields.description: Cardholder's work phone extension code. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1589 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: EmailAddress1
request_fields.description: E Mail Address 1 of Cardholder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @. Example: [email protected] Condition: If the validation parameter is set on the product for Primary Email Address then it will be mandatory. Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: WorkFaxNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder's Work Fax Number Valid values: 0-9 Example:9632581470 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: EmailAddress2
request_fields.description: E Mail Address 2 of Card holder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @. Example : [email protected] Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Date of Birth of cardholder Format: yyyymmdd Valid Values: 0-9 Example : 19800101 Allowable Values: 8

request_fields.name: HomePhoneCountryCode
request_fields.description: Home Phone Country Code Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 91 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: Phone
request_fields.description: Phone number of cardholder Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9876543210 Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.
